The diamond axe crafting requires specific materials (diamonds + sticks) that will be provided in the scene, and once crafted, the diamond axe is needed to efficiently mine bamboo (bamboo can be mined by hand but the axe makes it instant and represents the intended tool progression). This creates a branching DAG where finding cobblestone and crafting the diamond axe are parallel prerequisites that converge on mining bamboo, while mine_damaged_anvil depends on finding cobblestone first (the anvil is located in the cobblestone area).

The anvil is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5) inside the cobblestone enclosure. This is the most direct check for a mining task — the mined item appears in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond axe places it directly in the player's inventory. The player has 3 diamonds and 2 sticks, and a crafting table is at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 0). The recipe is 3 diamonds + 2 sticks. This is the standard check for craft tasks — the crafted item ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining bamboo drops bamboo items into the player's inventory. Bamboo plants are placed at spawn-relative positions around (9-12, 1, -3 to -4) on podzol. When broken (by hand or with any tool), bamboo drops as an inventory item. Checking for at least 1 bamboo in inventory confirms the mining task is complete.

Player starts with 3 diamonds, 2 sticks, and an iron pickaxe for mining the anvil.
task_text: Find the cobblestone structure ahead, mine the damaged anvil inside it using your iron pickaxe, craft a diamond axe at the crafting table behind you using your diamonds and sticks, then use the axe to mine bamboo from the grove to your right.

Damaged anvil sits inside at ~5,0,5 on the cobblestone floor. Bamboo grove (5 plants on podzol) is to the right at ~8-12,Y0-1,-3 to -4. Crafting table is behind spawn at ~-3,0,0. Iron pickaxe provided to mine the anvil. 3 diamonds + 2 sticks for diamond axe recipe.
